Class TypeAbstractException<T>

java.lang.Object
com.kamikazejam.kamicommon.command.type.TypeAbstract<T>
com.kamikazejam.kamicommon.command.type.TypeAbstractException<T>
All Implemented Interfaces:
Type<T>, Named
Direct Known Subclasses:
TypeAbstractSimple
public abstract class TypeAbstractException<T> extends TypeAbstract<T>
A Type base for parsing that signals failure by throwing. Implement valueOf(String, CommandSender) and let it throw anything on bad input; read(String, CommandSender) catches that and rethrows a KamiCommonException carrying extractErrorMessageMini(String, CommandSender, Exception), which defaults to the thrown exception's own message and is meant to be overridden for anything a player will read.
